title: Preserving Green Spaces and Heritage in Jalan Kayu Constituency
what_it_is: Preserving Green Spaces and Heritage in Jalan Kayu Constituency

sections.label: Constituency HDB and private estates
sections.summary: The constituency comprises three HDB estates and four private estates, including Jalan Kayu, Gerald-Mugliston, Luxus Hills and Seletar Aerospace Park.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: In fact, the constituency comprises three Housing and Development Board (HDB) estates – Ang Mo Kio Avenue 3 and Avenue 10, Serangoon North Avenue 3 and Avenue 4, Buangkok Crescent, Buangkok Link and Buangkok Green.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: It is also made up of four private estates, one of which is Jalan Kayu private estate, the other three are Gerald-Mugliston, Luxus Hills and Seletar Aerospace Park.

sections.label: URA Masterplan for Kampong Lorong Buangkok
sections.summary: Under the URA Masterplan 2014 (Revised), Kampong Lorong Buangkok will make way for a three-lane expressway and two schools.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Under the Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) Masterplan 2014 (Revised), Kampong Lorong Buangkok will make way for a three-lane expressway and the construction of two schools, presumably a primary and a secondary school.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar
sentences.text: Under the URA Masterplan, the land where the kampung is, will be made into two schools – like I said earlier, presumably one primary and one secondary school, and another highway.

sections.label: Kampong Lorong Buangkok residents and rent
sections.summary: Kampong Lorong Buangkok, on about 1.22 hectares, has 26 families paying monthly rent of $6 to $30 to landlady Ms Sng Mui Hong.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar
sentences.text: This is the last kampung we have left on our mainland, situated on a land of about 1.22 hectares.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar
sentences.text: There are 26 families or households living in Kampong Lorong Buangkok, each paying a monthly rent of between $6 to $30 to the landlady, a 65-year-old lady named Ms Sng Mui Hong.

sections.label: Retaining kampong as heritage education site
sections.summary: The speaker says the kampong should be retained as a conservation or heritage education site to teach younger generations about kampung living and spirit.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar
sentences.text: The changes they have observed and experienced over the years make for good case studies and rich learning for us and, for me, it is useful for the Change Management module I teach my students, which includes topics on urbanisation and gentrification and managing societal change.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar
sentences.text: We should retain the kampong as a conservation or heritage education site, where we can educate our younger generations about how kampung living was like and, more importantly, what the kampung spirit is about.

sections.label: Road need, LTA study, nature park proposal
sections.summary: The speaker asks LTA to study surrounding road usage to justify the Buangkok Drive extension highway and proposes a linear nature park instead.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar
sentences.text: The need to build this road must be contingent on the use of other surrounding roads – Buangkok Drive, Buangkok Crescent, Buangkok Link, Buangkok Green and Yio Chu Kang Road – in terms of traffic volume that these other roads are not able to support.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar
sentences.text: I have requested LTA to carry out a study of the usage of the roads mentioned above to justify the need to build the Buangkok Drive extension highway.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar
sentences.text: However, I beseech the Ministry of National Development (MND) to consider if we can shelve the plans to build this road.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar
sentences.text: I would instead propose making the strip of land as a linear nature park, with proper footpaths to connect Fernvale HDB estate and Gerald-Mugliston estate, and to put in place cycling tracks, while retaining the flora that is growing there naturally.

sections.label: Land parcels for schools, park, road
sections.summary: Two land parcels are safeguarded for a primary and secondary school, one for a park, and one earmarked for a major road to Seletar.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Two of the land parcels have been safeguarded for a primary school and a secondary school.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Another land parcel will form part of a park, and the last portion of the kampong site has been earmarked for a major road to Seletar, as the Member has indicated in the map earlier.

sections.label: Critical need for road
sections.summary: HDB and LTA assessed a critical need for the road because almost 10,000 new homes will be completed in Fernvale, Sengkang West and Hougang by 2022.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: HDB and LTA have assessed that there is a critical need for this road because almost 10,000 new homes will be completed in Fernvale, Sengkang West and Hougang between now and 2022, which is very soon.
